messages:
matt: Heads-up — Lotus (dedicated pool 'lotus-prod' in us-west-2) reported a latency regression since ~03:00 UTC. p95 from ~700ms -> ~1.9s, p99 spikes to ~3.2s. Any recent runtime changes?
jin: Not seeing any runtime deploys after 02:40. Are they on Dedicated (confirmed) or Hosted?
matt: Dedicated, verified. I attached the support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/12345 — I'll paste traces there.
support-bot: Ticket #12345 linked to thread and customer notified.
sara: I'll run a controlled benchmark against lotus-prod canaries. @lucas can you pre-warm KV caches for that pool?
lucas: On it. Kicking off cache-warm job across us-west-2 lotus nodes now.
sara: Running bench:```bash
rbench run --pool=lotus-prod --region=us-west-2 --seq=512 --concurrency=8 --samples=200
```
deploy-bot: No recent rolling deploys. Last infra patch was 5d ago (id: infra-2026-03-12).
jin: While Sara runs that, can someone grep kernel selector logs for fallbacks? e.g.```bash
grep -i "KERNEL_FALLBACK" /var/log/runtime/runtime.log | tail -n 50
```
sara: Bench results so far on canary: p95 ~1.7s, p50 ~420ms. Local microbench (no network) p95 ~820ms. KV miss rate looks high — host metrics show KV hit ~38%.
matt: Customer mentions more cold starts and a spike in tokenization time at the same window. I added their trace snippet to the ticket.
lucas: Cache-warm complete on 4/5 nodes, hit rate jumped to ~92% on warm nodes. Rolling the last node now. Expecting improvement in ~10m :crossed_fingers: 
sara: I'll continue 5m rolling benches and post updated numbers. If latency drops on the warm nodes, we can correlate to cache miss.
matt: OK — if no improvement in 20m we should escalate to eng-sre for a kernel rollback plan. pinging @eng-sre in the ticket.
jin: Adding perf traces link to ticket: https://perf.redwood.ai/traces/2187654321 — storing profiler and flamegraphs. Putting next actions into the ticket checklist.
support-bot: Customer updated: "Thanks — we're seeing some improvement but still intermittent spikes. Please keep us posted." ETA for next update: 30m.
